bibl.title: Four Newly Identified Fragments of P.Bodmer 14-15 (P75).
bibl.seg: Brent Nongbri & Daniel B. Sharp, Four Newly Identified Fragments of P.Bodmer 14-15 (P75).
bibl.note: P. Bodmer XIV-XV (= van Haelst 406; LDAB 2895). - Although none of these placements yields important new readings, they do remove uncertainty for some letters in the published editions, and it seemed worthwhile to us to document the existence, location, and contents of these fragments.
